articles.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
articles.description: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

articles.title: Iran says it has a 'new operational plan' if the U.S. resumes attacks, as shipping vessels report strikes
articles.description: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said the country's military has prepared a response to any new attacks.

articles.title: Most Americans polled oppose betting on elections: Reuters
articles.description: The prediction market industry enables people to bet on US ‌elections and sporting events.

articles.title: Boomers are buying into the promise of monthly income from options ETFs, but there's a tax catch
articles.description: Covered call ETFs have been widely adopted by baby boomers to meet monthly income needs, but unlike most ETFs, the tax implications can be significant.

articles.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
articles.description: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
articles.description: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

articles.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
articles.description: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

articles.title: Trump waives broad new Russia sanctions, Zelenskyy condemns it as 'wrong'
articles.description: Trump signed the Graham Bill, which targeted Russia over its invasion of Ukraine, into law in September.

articles.title: Top Wall Street analysts are bullish on the growth potential of these 3 stocks
articles.description: Amid fear of rate hikes and oil prices, investors can look past volatility and track Street analysts' stock picks with strong long-term growth potential.

articles.title: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
articles.description: AI always-listening wearables from Apple, Amazon, Meta and other startups are getting creative with privacy rules and fueling concerns about covert recordings.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
articles.description: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

articles.title: Semiconductor market to remain solid ‘at least through next year,’ South Korea finance minister says
articles.description: South Korea's finance minister said semiconductor growth can last at least through 2027 as supply remains tight despite a global chip sell-off.

articles.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
articles.description: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

articles.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
articles.description: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

articles.title: Trump's Russia diesel deal may offer Putin more than money — and spell trouble for Ukraine
articles.description: Trump's diesel deal may do little for Russia's finances, but it raises bigger questions about Ukraine's leverage, U.S. support and Putin's next moves.

articles.title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
articles.description: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.

articles.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
articles.description: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

articles.title: Why hedge funds could be making a bond market shock more likely
articles.description: The Bank of England's deputy governor has warned that hedge funds' activities could raise the risk of a global bond market shock.

articles.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
articles.description: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.

articles.title: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
articles.description: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million—days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House races.
